---
description: "Use when writing or editing blog posts. Keep the author's British English and informal engineer's voice."
applyTo: "content/post/**/*.md"
---

# Blog writing

- Use British English.
- Keep the writing direct, informal, and in the voice of an engineer describing their own work.
- Don't over-polish grammar or punctuation; prefer natural phrasing over editorial or corporate prose.
- Preserve the author's meaning and technical detail when editing.
